description: This source file defines extension methods for the ChannelsStore class, providing asynchronous functions to load, update, and save configuration schemas and values, as well as utility functions for deep access and mutation within nested configuration data structures.

methods.name: loadConfigSchema
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the configuration schema from a remote source and updates the local state with the received schema and UI hints.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the current configuration snapshot from a remote source, updating local configuration state and UI components accordingly.

methods.name: applyUIConfig
methods.description: Applies UI-related configuration settings such as 'seamColorHex' based on the loaded configuration snapshot.

methods.name: channelConfigSchema
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration schema for a specific channel based on its ID.

methods.name: configValue
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration value at a specified path within the draft configuration, with fallback for channel-specific paths.

methods.name: updateConfigValue
methods.description: Updates the draft configuration at a specified path with a new value, marking the configuration as dirty.

methods.name: saveConfigDraft
methods.description: Saves the current draft configuration to persistent storage and reloads the latest configuration from the remote source.

methods.name: reloadConfigDraft
methods.description: Reloads the configuration from the remote source, replacing the draft.
